summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $4.17/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $4.17 a gallon across Wisconsin as of October 17, 2026, according to GasBuddy. AAA figures put the statewide average 9¢ higher than a week ago, 11¢ lower than a month ago, and $1.59 higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Milwaukee ($3.92) and the highest in Superior ($4.36).
